services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: Bring your friends and enjoy a stay in this cozy and comfortable cabin! The interior thoughtfully features two bunk beds, each equipped with full-size beds, providing ample space for a restful night's sleep. 2 Full Sized Beds and 2 Twin Sized Beds arranged in a convenient bunk style configuration Wi-Fi available. Linens are NOT included, so please bring your own bedding and towels. No pets allowed on the property. Family-friendly cabin rentals, RV rentals, spacious RV sites, and tenting options available in beautiful Zanesville,
